verdict.rationale: Kino AI exposes an MCP server so external agents can edit projects. Its '100+ templates' are video design assets (titles, maps, captions, transitions), not a skill spec, skill template, or meta-skill an agent could follow to author and package a new skill. Nothing in the pack documents skill authoring or packaging, and a community user explicitly notes that reusable templates are missing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
